name: People
description: All individuals who interact with the SafeFlow platform, including tenants, engineers, supervisors, property managers, administrators, and contractor contacts. Used for identity resolution, notification routing, and communication preferences.
record_count_estimate: Medium volume - hundreds to low thousands of people across all sites

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each person

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: Person's first name or given name

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Concatenated full name for display purposes

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for notifications and correspondence

fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.description: WhatsApp number in +44 format used for automated messaging and notifications

fields.name: role
fields.description: Primary role of the person within the SafeFlow system, determining access levels and notification routing

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Link to the site this person is associated with (e.g. where the tenant resides or the engineer is based)

fields.name: unit_number
fields.description: Unit, flat, or suite number within the site (primarily for tenants)

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the person is currently active in the system. Inactive records are retained for audit purposes

fields.name: preferred_language
fields.description: Preferred language for communications and notifications. Used to select appropriate message templates

fields.name: notification_preferences
fields.description: JSON object defining notification preferences, including channels (whatsapp, email, sms), quiet hours, and digest frequency

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the person record was first created

fields.name: last_interaction_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent interaction (message sent or received) involving this person

views.name: All People
views.description: Complete list of all people in the system

views.name: By Role
views.description: All people grouped by their role for role-based management

views.name: Active Tenants
views.description: Active tenant records for tenant communication and issue reporting

views.name: Engineers
views.description: All internal engineers available for work item assignment

views.name: Property Managers
views.description: Property managers responsible for site oversight and approval workflows
